plan.name: Strategy 1: Systematic Search and Clean
plan.strategy: Search all possible storage locations systematically, clean the pan if needed, and place it on the countertop.
steps: Check all cabinets (1-6) for a pan.
If not found in cabinets, check drawers (1-3).
If not found in drawers, check shelves (1-3).
If not found in shelves, check the sink basin or stove burners.
Once a pan is found, check if it is already clean.
If the pan is not clean, use the sink basin to clean it.
After cleaning, place the pan on the countertop (1-3).
